text: GOOOAAAAALLLL!! 1-1!! LUTON EQUALISE! The Hatters throw everything forward and Townsend gets the ball out of his feet on the right-hand side before delivering a dangerous ball into the penalty area.
GOOOOOAAAAAALLLL!!! 1-0 PALACE!! Doughty looks to pass the ball back to his goalkeeper, but he doesn't get enough on it and Munoz races through on goal.
He takes it past Kaminski and looks to chip it back towards goal, but he fails to hit the target! He has to be scoring from there!
Huge chance for Palace! Eze feeds the ball to Mitchell inside the penalty area and he stands up his marker before creating space for a cross.
What a chance! Wharton finds Eze on the left-hand side and he delivers into the penalty area.
Luton hit the bar! Doughty's cross into the penalty area looks as though it's heading out for a goal-kick, but Ogbene does superbly to help it back into the danger zone.
Morris gets there first and heads towards goal, but it's straight at Johnstone and the Palace goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
